Item 5 report — what s15_integrated_harness/trace_runtime.py writes to disk for one tool call:

1) One file per run only: traces/run_<UTC-stamp>_<runid>.jsonl, created 0o600 with O_APPEND|O_EXCL, line-buffered (L200-219); first line `run_start` (L239-250). HARNESS_TRACE=0 → NullTraceRecorder writes nothing (L184-185, L614-615).
2) Every event = one flushed JSON line: _write (L258-265); emit builds the record (L283-312): schema_version, timestamp, monotonic_ns, elapsed_ms, run_id, turn_id, event_id, event, agent_id/parent_agent_id/agent_kind, span_id/parent_span_id, caused_by/depends_on, thread, data.
3) A single tool call = 2 lines via span() (L316-369): start event (L331-339) and end event (L361-369) with status ok/error (L352-358) + duration_ms (L357-359).
4) If the tool triggers model calls: +2 lines each from TracedMessages.create — model_request (L534-536 with purpose/model/counts L521-533) and model_response/model_error (L539-548, L581-588).
5) No raw secrets/full payloads: safe_value (L451-480) masks secret keys/text (L30-44) and replaces strings >2048 chars by {characters, sha256, preview, truncated} (L470-476); summarize_output (L482-493) yields 500-char preview + sha256, full text only when HARNESS_TRACE_OUTPUT=full.
6) finish_run (L495-505, atexit L238) appends `run_end` and closes. Net disk footprint per tool call: 2 JSONL lines (4+ if model calls occur) in the one run file.
